verdict.rationale: An official Python SDK is documented covering conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management, plus a companion CLI, so the parse and extract surfaces are reachable from Python. There is no evidence of a TypeScript SDK, and nothing shows the SDK is typed or what its defaults are. missing for 10: a TypeScript SDK, evidence of typed interfaces, confirmed SDK coverage of jobs/segmentation/agent endpoints, documented defaults, independent hands-on corroboration.
